name: Angel Shrimp
instructions: The measurements for the mint and parsley are approximate
I don't measure i just use what looks to me like the amounts i have listed
I am always very close when i measure that way
Please use what looks right to you , using these measurements as a guide
Cook pasta according to package directions
Drain and toss with the mint , parsley , extra virgin olive oil and salt and pepper
Heat extra virgin olive oil in a skillet and add shrimp
Cook for 3 minutes stirring often ~ or grill~ just follow same guidelines and grill over a hot grill until shrimp are pink
They cook fast ! do not overcook !
Add garlic and cook 1 more minute
Toss shrimp with prepared pasta and serve with fresh cracked black pepper
Also great garnished with some freshly grated parmesan cheese
Don't forget to imbibe in the remaining alcohol if you are adding it to this dish !
